question: I'm a CS 5th-year student currently on academic warning. I have several remaining graduation requirements and want to register for an overloaded course load next semester to finish faster. Is this permitted?
expected_answer: No — the academic actions policy explicitly states that a student on an academic action (including academic warning) cannot overload. P-009 is restricted to a normal course load while on academic warning, regardless of the desire to accelerate degree completion.
common_mistake: Assuming that a compelling reason (urgency to graduate) creates an exception to the overload prohibition; not knowing that academic warning explicitly blocks overloads
needs_verification: Confirm P-009 is currently on academic warning (appears so from the record)
Confirm the policy language: 'A student on an academic action cannot overload, study abroad, or take independent studies'
Confirm what constitutes 'normal course load' for a 5th-year CS student (typically 360 units / 8 semesters = ~45 units)
